text:
Jordan (PM): quick heads-up: traffic projections just moved our target SLA into a stricter band. we need a cutlist for the next ship window ASAP. my starter proposal: 1) ship MVP = chat core + embeddings read/write 2) defer per-tenant analytics + CSV export to v1 3) make model-explainability an enterprise opt-in 4) reduce dedicated pool footprint by 40% and rely on autoscale for bursts. reactions?

Priya (Eng Lead): reducing pool footprint is fine but we need a fallback model path if peaks hit. otherwise we risk long tail latency. :thinking_face:

Carlos (SRE): agree on fallback. also recommend a short timeline shift (10 days) to finish safe fallback + test harness. canary without fallback = risky.

Olivia (Customer Success): customers on pilot asked for tenant-level analytics. if we cut it they need a mitigation: offer a simple weekly CSV export and a raw logs endpoint for the pilots. low effort but keeps them happy.

Mei (Design): if analytics moves to v1, we should hide related UI flows in MVP but keep placeholders so pilots know it's coming. small banner + "request export" CTA.

Priya (Eng Lead): technical note: model-explainability touches inference pipeline heavily. making it opt-in helps but we should gate it behind a feature flag to avoid perf regressions. I'll add a runtime toggle.

Jordan (PM): ok action items forming. decision draft: cut per-tenant analytics and CSV export from MVP; offer weekly export for pilots; model-explainability as opt-in behind flag; reduce dedicated pool by 40% with fallback model routing. propose shifting GA 10 days to finish fallback and run canary.

Carlos (SRE): canary plan: 3% traffic for 72h, telemetry check at 6h, 24h, 48h. metrics: median latency <=250ms, p95 <=450ms, error rate <0.3%. will create alerting runbook.

Olivia (Customer Success): I'll notify pilots and prep the export process. need a short FAQ for pilots about limitations and manual workarounds.

Mei (Design): I'll remove analytics screens from MVP flows and add the CTA for exports + banner. quick mock by tomorrow morning.

Priya (Eng Lead): owners: Priya = fallback routing + feature flag, Carlos = canary + alerts, Jordan = stakeholder comms, Olivia = pilot comms, Mei = UI updates.

Jordan (PM): small code snippet for feature flag toggle for the rollout doc: ```yaml
feature_flags:
  model_explainability: false # enable in v1 or via opt-in
```

release-bot: Deploy window locked: 2026-05-20 02:00 UTC  canary target 3% for 72h.

Priya (Eng Lead): i'll prep a short rollback script and put it in the release PR. snippet: ```sh
# rollback quick command
./deploy --rollback last-stable
```

Carlos (SRE): will codify the 6h telemetry checks and add an automated rollback trigger if p95 > 700ms for 10m.

Jordan (PM): final ask: if nobody objects by EOD I'll update the roadmap and lock the cutlist + shift GA by 10 days. thumbs?

Priya (Eng Lead): +1 from eng.

Carlos (SRE): +1 from infra.

Mei (Design): +1 design.

Olivia (Customer Success): +1. i'll start pilot comms.

Jordan (PM): locking cuts and the 10-day timeline reset. I'll send updated roadmap links and a short exec note after this thread. thanks all.
